rules: Only selected exact occurrences are blue; ordinary words are not made clickable.
Context glosses are prewritten lexical meanings, never question answers, analyses or full passage translations.
Other common senses are authored lexical notes; monosemous entries explicitly have no additional common sense.
No runtime AI, network dictionary, stemming or sense guessing.
Source text, question objects, fingerprints and personal study data are not modified.
Oxford B2/C1 headwords screen candidates; levels do not certify every sense, and unlisted words are not automatically C2.
A recorded annotation count is not proof that every B2/C1/C2 sense has been reviewed. See source/b2-vocabulary/coverage.json.
